reviews.text:
nice, air-conditioned and quiet, just right for a very nervous cat.
2nd visit to trim nails this year, much easier and completed with no blood shed! very happy.

My Rabbit hates us looking after his claws so we decided to take him to his vets.Booking an appointment is easy and the times offered are good.I really like the weekend opening times as it acknowledges that not all pet owners work regular hours.
The staff are always lovely and I think my rabbit secretly loves the attention he gets!

Staff is great and the vets aas well, I appreciate all the work they do, the lady from reception is great. Thank you for keeping my Dachshund healthy and getting her well when she was sick.
Reception lady Moai says Hi!

Great vet, she handled Kato very well as he is nervous and a trip to the vets not high on his list of fun things to do.
Still £25 for a prescription!!
Very friendly and helpful

Thank you for such a lovely experience at Leya’s appointment.

All the staff were so kind, welcoming and lovely, and Leya was looked after so well. The vet who saw her was incredibly informative, knowledgeable and reassuring, and took the time to explain everything clearly, which I really appreciated.

It was such a positive experience from start to finish, and I felt very reassured that Leya was in such good hands.

Thank you again to the whole team!

Best wishes,
Adriana
Top marks for for the achievement with Pablo and he eye problems and Pablo just loves this place and all of the team👍🐾
Took our kitten here for his first vet appointment and the experience was definitely positive :)
All of my concerns were addressed for my ageing labrador with great care and professionalism
Staff are always welcoming and great with my cat.

My dog loves visiting Medivet and he especially loves Holly his vet together with all the staff.  They make such a fuss of him.
He actually pulls me once we get nearby.
Very caring and helpful vets, but the fee price is very high.

I took my guinea pig in to have his nails clipped. It was our first visit. The staff were very friendly. There was parking available which was great. We were seen on time and everything went well. I would definitely recommend and go again if needed.
As always our guinea pig Violet got lots of attention when she visited to have her claws clipped. The nurse was professional and caring. Thank you for your kindness.

We switched to this Medivet as we needed a vet with a specialism in ophthalmology for our cat. However we’ve been with them ever since, even though they’re not necessarily the closest to us. The staff are friendly but professional and I feel like my cats, so far, have been well looked after and treated appropriately.
From the staff to care given my cats are always well cared and received the best treatment possible.
Always receive great service at Medivet Clerkenwell. I know my pet is well cared for here.
The vet was amazing, saw my dog very quickly and was very informative thank you

Both the staff and the veterinarian were super friendly. The veterinarian was gentle and patient when checking my cat. She was professional throughout the appointment, took the time to thoroughly explain my cat's dental health state to me, and gave me helpful advice on how to care for it going forward. She made me feel at ease, and I really appreciated how kind and reassuring she was. Overall, it was a great experience, I highly recommend the practice.
Kind and great care for my elderly cat. The bill was about what I expected. Very professional and nice.
Anoushka was brilliant!  She was thorough and ensured we felt totally informed and treated our cats with real love and care.

This practice is simply great!!! Always find appointment when needed, very friendly, staff actually do care about our dog, receptionists and doctors are very professional, caring, friendly and provide fantastic services and care for our dog. I have been with few other vets before, so I can compare. This practice stands beyond all of them. Thank you so much. We really appreciate everything you have done for our dog.
Great practice, they genuinely care for your pets
Always very pleased with care for my 10 year old wonderful cat
Excellent care

Caring and always available when needed. The staff seem to genuinely care. Last time I was here a family brought an injured bird in off the street and they didn’t hesitate in treating it and calling the National Wildlife Trust. Medivet in general are quite expensive, so we went elsewhere to get our dog spayed (literally 4 times more expensive at medivet), but for everything else that our insurance covers we don’t hesitate to come here.

Honestly such an incredible vet practice. We have taken our rabbits here for a few years now and they have provided such incredible care, particularly our vet Tana. Everyone at reception is also so friendly and helpful. Feel very lucky to have access to them, especially with very limited vets for rabbits (all exotics). Highly recommend!

Tana is an exceptional vet who has always provided honest expertise and compassionate advice for my bunnies, right up to end of life. The whole medivet team are so friendly and obviously really care for the animals that come through their doors. Thanks to all the team and especially Tana for the past few years x

Never had a problem in years with this practice but the last visit they obviously hadn't checked my cats medical file from previous visits, I was late being seen and then very rushed and the receptionist was quite rude.  Hopefully next visit they will be back to their normal selves or I might consider changing

We just wanted to say a heartfelt thank you for the wonderful care you’ve given to Coco. From the moment we walk through the door, we’re always met with kindness, professionalism, and genuine compassion—not just for Coco, but for us as well.

It’s so reassuring to know she’s in such capable and caring hands. Your patience, attention to detail, and willingness to explain everything clearly make such a difference, especially during more worrying moments. Coco is always treated with such gentleness and respect, and it means the world to us.

We truly appreciate everything you do and feel very lucky to have such a dedicated team looking after her. Thank you again for all your hard work and kindness.

We were hoping this will be our vet but unfortunately we have to choose someone else. We took our cat -first time cat parents, for her first doctor appointment and the vet had a very quick examination, told us her teeth are bad and she needs medicine, took a long time talking to us about the more than expensive neutering procedure and didn’t spent any time checking our cat for anything wrong. Turns out the cat had fleas, which she brought to our home from the previous home. It’s sad that even Vets in this country are trained to sell services over properly examining animals. The staff were lovely, I just think this is the business’ policy they have to follow.
The staff at Medivet Clerkenwell are always great with my pups. Would recommend them to anyone!

Always amazing service at Medivet Clerkenwell. Their health plan is great and comprehensive, and the vets and reception staff are so friendly. This team makes vet visits a very pleasant experience — we always leave confident about what’s happening and happy for the support!

Brought in our terrapin to the vets.
The receptionist was so lovely and the vet was so helpful, gave us a lot of information on getting our terrapin better, thank you x
I brought my 2-year-old cat in for an annual check-up and was very pleased with the doctor’s professionalism and the quality of the advice provided.
Excellent service, great care and friendly staff. I am very pleased with the care we received. Thank you so much

Tana and the team at Medivet are absolute angels. We've been going here for the last 3 years with our rabbits and the team are always top tier. Tana's experience is phenomenal and we couldn't be more grateful through the good times and the sad.

I came in as an emergency to obtain an Animal Health Certificate, as I was travelling the same day and the vet I originally had an appointment with did not, in the end, have the necessary documents. I was taken care of immediately.

The reception staff fully understood the situation I was in and did everything they could to find a solution. The vet was very kind and pleasant, as were the reception staff, who even offered me a coffee while I was waiting.

Thank you again! I highly recommend them.
Thank you for your review. Your rating is really appreciated.
Had a great experience with this vet when they nurtured my xl bully brilliant vets ⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐
I have been using them since 2022 as I moved in the area. The vets and the team at reception are super friendly and helpful.
Fantastic staff, incredibly kind and caring receptionists…l feel our cat is in great hands here.

I want to say thank you to the team at Medivet for their support since the beginning I was treated with love when my budgie passed away. They continue to show their support it’s been around a month since and this beautiful card arrived today unexpectedly. I wanted to give my gratitude
Systemized Price extortion with a smile. £900 for a UTI for a dog. Outrageous.

I highly recommend NOT using this veterinary company, my explanation is too long. This particular veterinary clinic Used to be good, but in the last couple of years it’s gone completely downhill Total disinterest total lack of accountability  it’s a chain so I think their lies the problem. Find a family vets . Our pets are special !  In the last couple of years, we didn’t get the feeling from The vets or the  staff that this is the case we will not be using them again we had a long relationship, but like I said before, it was taken over and the last 2  years beyond bad service. If I could give zero stars I would.

I’m so grateful for Tatiana and Dr. Holly. Tatiana made dealing with my insurance so much easier, and Dr. Holly is incredibly empathetic. My cat Soju adores her, and I truly appreciate the care she’s taken in finding the best referrals for us.

I've been with Medivet Clerkenwell for a bit over a year now and both of my cats are registered here. I've had a great experience with this vet -- both of my cats are seen regularly, have received all vaccinations, been microchipped, and were neutered here. They've both had top tier care. Even when I moved, I decided to stay with this vet because of how friendly and competent everyone who works here is. I would highly recommend this vet!
Consistently excellent

I wanted to share an updated review since my last. Dr. Tana, Essi, and the whole team just continue to be the best veterinarian practice and most caring, driven, and passionate team that I have ever dealt with. Since Phoebe, they have also cared for her sister Frances and most recently Tiny.  All three of our girls had treatment that all extended their lives in quality and quantity due to their care.  Through the devastating and heart shattering passings of our girls, and most recently our beloved angel Tiny a few days ago- their unwavering support has kept us calm and focused on celebrating their lives while they lift the grief away from us which I didn't think could be possible. I left our beautiful angel Tiny with them today, and for the first time in a few days I am at peace knowing that Essi and Dr. Tana will be handling her with the upmost respect and dignity that most people would be even lucky to receive.  I am so grateful to have met such a brilliant team of people to care for my girls, and am truly honoured to know every talented person at this clinic who are changing the world around them. Their ambition with care has certainly changed our world for the better.  It feels silly giving them a rating because what they have provided for me goes beyond a google review and rating.

Everyone is so nice in this clinic! I took my new dog for a first time vet appointment and she felt really good! No stress at all 😊 the doctor explained every little detail during our appointment and my beautiful Freya didn’t even feel the vaccine and enjoyed being pampered during her visit! We even got the plan for her as I felt very happy with the doctor, the nurses and the whole team! Can’t recommend them enough!
Took Leo for his 6 month check up great staff very friendly

I had a couple subpar vet experiences hence tried Medivet. Easy to book, lovely vet (she was very gentle and loving towards my puppy) and good membership prices. Both prices and attitude of staff was significantly better than what I experienced at Goddard. 10/10 would recommend Medivet!
We love Clerkenwell Medivet, my dog Ralph has been with then since we got him at 11 weeks old. We moved house and stayed with then so it’s a way to travel now but I Wouldn’t change vet centre.
Amazing vets! Staff were helpful, efficient and so lovely to my dog and to me. I’ve been to a few different Medivet practices and this is by far the best.
Extremely rude receptionist.
Excellent practice from the reception team to the vets and nurses. Always explain everything fully and feel my Pickle gets the best advice and treatment from a wonderful team
Fantastic service every time. The team is always friendly, knowledgeable, and helpful. Everyone I’ve met has been lovely with my dog, and I really appreciate the care and attention they give.
Really friendly, helpful and knowledgable team at Medivet Clerkenwell. Never had to wait long to talk to them and never felt rushed with their time. Would definitely recommend!

Medivet Clerkenwell provided an exceptionally distressing and concerning experience that I feel compelled to share. My one-star rating is solely for the vet, as the overall environment was far below any acceptable standard for pet care.

Upon arrival for our scheduled appointment, we were met with a significant delay, caused by a highly agitated young staff member struggling to open the door. Her demeanor was alarming; she aggressively stated she "did not normally work there," that they were "understaffed," and that she had been working elsewhere since 7 AM. Adding to the chaos, she was actively advising customers on the phone not to attend the practice due to understaffing. This outburst was not only unprofessional but also threatening, creating an immediate sense of unease.

The atmosphere at Medivet Clerkenwell is neither nice nor safe for pets or their owners. The combination of disorganization and the threatening behavior of staff makes it impossible for us to consider returning. I would welcome the opportunity for the practice to discuss this matter further, as such an experience is simply unacceptable.

My dog has been a long Medivet patient since she was a puppy and I cannot recommend them highly enough. All the veterinarians are very kind, patient and thorough in explaining things. Especially Filipa and Mark who were very kind. I am grateful we have a trustworthy vets like Medivet across London.

Had to take my parents' dog in for an eye operation. From the reception staff to the nurses and vets, there was a warm welcome both for myself and the dog. The staff are able to build a rapport quickly. Special thanks to Mark, Karen and Phillipa for dealing with a challenging patient who was intent on escaping from his cone!

Been to countless vets globally, and this one has caused the most traumatic experience for my cat.  My cat had always been friendly at vets, even when needled or getting suppository checks etc, always rubbing against the doctors and nurses.  However, after a traumatic experience at this vet
which handled her very roughly, she is now always afraid to go to vets and hisses at the doctors and nurses. This vet has even lost her favourite blanket overnight which I repeatedly requested that they hold on to. They seem to do okay with simple checks and treatment, but for a more complex procedure or treatment, not nearly as close.  Please choose your vet wisely. There are plenty of vets that handle animals gently and with care and empathy.  Note that this bad experience was many years ago so the clinic may have changed for the better but I haven’t revisited
them since.
Thank you for your review. Your rating is really appreciated.

We had a wonderful experience at the clinic thanks to Elodie, who was incredibly gentle and caring with our cat. She made the whole visit calm and reassuring, we couldn’t be more grateful for her outstanding care. A big thank you as well to the lovely receptionist, whose kindness and warmth made everything feel even more comforting. It’s clear both genuinely care about cats, and it made all the difference!

The vets and nurses are always kind and compassionate.   They have been wonderful with our very elderly cats, providing excellent care and advice about balancing the benefits with giving them a peaceful old age.

Not great, I booked for a dental package - seems I could only book at the time of booking for 'free dental check' and the very small print showed a limited time for the dental package which I hadn't seen and didn't make itself known when I booked the check - very misleading ad, vet I saw couldn't have been quicker, looked at cat, spoke very quickly and I was out.  Didn't feel confident she was doing any more than box ticking.

So welcoming, nice and professional! Our first visit to Clerkenwell branch and both the receptionist lady and Anoushka (the vet who saw Pepe and gave the booster vaccine) were super nice!

They answered thousands of my questions and were very thorough with the check-up and the vaccine process! Will definitely be back in this branch as the staff is brilliant!!!
Very considerate staff. Very efficient.
Thank you for your review. Your rating is really appreciated.
Professional & friendly.

I cannot recommend Medivet enough! They recently suggested a comprehensive health plan for my dog and I couldn't be happier with the level of care and attention they offer. Their expertise and dedication to animal well-being truly set them apart.

Highly recommended, my dog has been looked after by this vet for a while and after a spinal injury, he was seen on a Sunday by emergency vet , referred and operated on in a day.. he's now walking again and doing really well... Thanks for your care and support 🙏 …
This is an excellent practice .  The staff are extremely professional and provide a very high level of care.

We can't recommend Medivet Clerkenwell enough. Leo has been coming here for the last 4 years. We are currently in the process of moving to Colombia and the practise has been so helpful, from the vets to the receptionists going above and beyond to help me find the right information and ensuring Leo has all he needs. Thank you to the team :)
Absolutely amazing staff and service, can't wait to go back for my kittens vaccinations & microchip!
I have been with Medivet Clerkenwell for a year now. Their support, advice and services have been great. Thank you again!

It is my first time using Medivet service since arrived in London last year. It is easy to make appointments online with timeslot suitable for me; and great service in general. The staff is very friendly and the vet is professional.
Thank you for leaving a review. Should you wish to discuss your rating in more detail, please email us at reviews@medivet.co.uk and a member of the team will be happy to contact you further.
Fantastic and incredibly helpful staff. Would highly recommend for any Issues big or small.
Thank you for your review. Your rating is really appreciated.
Great practice with great service. I would recommend signing up for the medivet plan.
Thank you for your review. Your rating is really appreciated.

Fantastic vets who are caring and kind. Tana is a brilliant vet, she sees my rabbits and was exceptionally compassionate and supportive when one of them, Roger, passed recently. The entire team at Clerkenwell are brilliant.

Thank you for your care!
(Photo of Roger <3)
Great service always and caring vets
REALLY great team of people - so kind, caring and professional. Special thanks to Mark and Tatiana for all the most recent support with Huffy!
Thank you for your review. Your rating is really appreciated.
The customer experience received from Holly and Billy made me feel that your setting is more than a vet clinic but a community who cares for its members.
Unresponsive. Test results three days late. Horrible since they were taken over by private equity

Been mine and my mother's family vet for some time now. They previously took great care of her pet rabbit and now continue to provide wonderful, warm care for my much beloved cat. They have have been very helpful in everything from emergencies, routine checkups, and even helped me recently with advice on insurance claims after my cat had been hospitalised unexpectedly when he couldn't breathe.

The lovely vet, Dr. Holly gave me easy to understand advice on what to do should this ever happen again and I left feeling comfortable the my much loved companion was ready to come home and I felt well informed.

They even offered me advice and were very patient with me filling out my insurance claims forms, even though they didn't have to help me as they had been paid. You can tell all the vet's and nurses and lovely staff members really do care about the animals and their humans.

I've been very happy with the care my dog has received at Medivet Clerkenwell, particularly in terms of how the team have approached handling her as this has always been done very sensitively to her individual needs. For example, she's …
